items.why: Volatility is spiking as stocks swoon on AI fears and investors rush to Treasuries, with the sell-off continuing on worries about AI, tariffs, and inflation.
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq slide is led by Nvidia, and headlines warn an AI wipeout could unleash unexpected consequences for the broader economy.
AMD is caught in the chip-led sell-off as the Nasdaq slides, with AI fears driving the broader tech rout.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: S&P futures down 1.32% and Nasdaq futures down 2.43% as the sell-off continues.
summary: Stocks are selling off in a tech-led slide, with the Nasdaq down sharply and chip names leading the drop. The VIX is spiking as investors fret about AI, tariffs, and inflation.
